blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Coherent dark-theme dashboard with restrained accent color, intentional CSS variable system, clear typographic hierarchy in panel labels, and a well-proportioned four-panel layout, but the force-directed network is too dense to read at rendered size and the thumbnail grid rows are visually undersized relative to the viewport space given to the upper panels.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Bar chart has correct zero baseline and data-driven monthly bins; node/point size correctly uses scaleSqrt; color-space axes use hardcoded but semantically justified domains (hue 0–360, lightness 0–100); minor issue: bin joins lack key functions, risking visual corruption on re-render.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces renders, but bitFilter.set()+filtered() run O(n) on every brush mousemove without debouncing, and the color brush rebuilds a brushedBlocks Set over all colorPoints on every drag event before the RAF fires.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four-panel crossfilter layout is well-structured and manageable, but the 60-node force network renders as a dense hairball at this scale — edge density after median-weight filtering remains high enough that structure is hard to read without hovering, and the color-usage scatter adds a second visually noisy panel alongside it.
